finding_summary: This is a genuinely LOW-VOLUME, HIGH-CPC, HIGH-INTENT B2B niche. Branded coaching/mastermind terms (contractor coaching, roofing business coach, construction business coaching) all sit under 100/mo search volume nationally — there are only a few thousand commercial coatings/roofing contracting businesses in the US, not a mass consumer market. CPC on the adjacent commercial-intent terms is high ($11-$85), confirming real buyer value per lead even at low volume. Organic-only SEO on branded coaching terms is not a viable primary channel; content-authority (operational how-to content that ranks for contractor pain-point searches) is the realistic path, same pattern as tracthomecontractor.com's 'tract home' finding.
